visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed photo background with dark overlay, ~900px tall at 1440 wide, centered serif h1 in white, italic subline, terracotta CTA button.
reuseGuidance: Use for page-opening statements over a photograph. Row 1: background image (with alt text). Row 2: rich text with an h1, a subline paragraph and a CTA link. For a hero without a full-bleed photo use the base hero block.
usageDescription: Top-of-page hero spanning the full viewport width: a background photo with a centered headline, a short subline and a single call-to-action (e.g. 'Talk to a Travel Advisor').
